title: Add athena.candidate/2 and have the core write chain fields
summary: Per the user's split, this job only adds the athena.candidate/2 record (base_fingerprint, optional previous_job) and has the core write those fields. The gate's chain landing rule, jobs/history changes and the "implemented" doc updates are left for the next job.

defaults_applied.how: Split per user: only the record schema and core writing in this job.
Tests for /2 parsing and core writing; cargo test and clippy must pass.
All changes are Rust plus Markdown docs.
Docs and changelog written for outside readers.

assumptions: Design doc docs/design/squash-chain-landing.md option B (D69) defines the field names and derivation of previous_job.
Consumers that match AnyRecord::Candidate need only minimal changes to accept /2.
The gate rule job (invariant.rs chain check, jobs.rs/history chain recording, enforcement.md rows, D69 implemented) is a separate later job.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena-data records.rs defines athena.candidate/2 with base_fingerprint and optional previous_job, registered in AnyRecord and the schema-name table; athena.candidate/1 still parses.
docs/records.md documents athena.candidate/2 and its two new fields.
athena-core run.rs writes /2 candidates with base_fingerprint computed from the base commit and previous_job set to the latest landed job in the base's history (absent if none).
store.rs and every other AnyRecord::Candidate consumer (scoring, athena-score, athena-git snapshot, gate jobs.rs) compile and handle /2 without changing gate landing, jobs or history rules.
Tests cover /2 round-trip, /1 still parsing, and the core writing base_fingerprint and previous_job (including previous_job absent when no job has landed).

Gate invariant.rs landing rule is unchanged (single-job refusal stays). The design doc is not marked implemented; at most a CHANGELOG/doc note says the record and core half is done and the gate rule is next. No governance file or records/ path changes.
Run cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets, and cargo fmt --check from the repo root; all pass.

out_of_scope: Gate landing chain check in invariant.rs and its refusal messages
jobs.rs check and history walk accepting multi-job chains
Gate chain tests (fork, unlinked, broken link, etc.)
Marking D69, design-doc status, enforcement.md or athena-v0.md §7.3 as implemented
